label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_00
text: 真是的，就這樣結束了？\n……哎呀。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_system_01
text: 大約１年多前……

label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_01
text: 梅洛，妳回來了！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_02
text: ……我讓幾隻炭小侍進化了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_03
text: 這樣應該能解決動力不足的問題了吧。\n相信天星隊車也能動了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_dokuboss_01
text: 真是可喜可賀，奧爾迪加閣下。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_fairyboss_01
text: 我還以為妳只是說說而已……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_04
text: 閉嘴！你老是多說一句不必要的話！\n你就是這一點很煩人！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_fairyboss_02
text: 梅洛可妳也半斤八兩吧……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_fairyboss_03
text: 妳說話難聽，態度又差，\n才會讓人看不順眼，不是嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_02
text: 那可不是喔，奧爾。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_03
text: 因為梅洛很可愛，\n總是被其他女孩嫉妒，\r\n她才會故意裝冷淡，說些難聽的話。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_04
text: 不過……\n結果還是因為這樣惹得別人看不順眼。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_05
text: 好了好了！\n枇琶姐，妳饒了我吧！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_akuboss_01
text: 就說到這裡吧。\n時間也差不多到了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_06
text: 終於要開始了，天星大作戰……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_dokuboss_02
text: 話說，真老大有何打算？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_akuboss_02
text: 這個嘛，真老大說已經把\n霸凌別人的學生們叫到操場去了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_06
text: 終於要開始了啊……！\n真叫人燃燒……燃燒起來了！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_07
text: 燒啊燒啊……\n燃燒殆盡了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_08
text: ……看來到此為止了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_10
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打贏了我！\n抬頭挺胸地把團隊徽章拿走吧！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_waza_01
text: 反正通通都無所謂了。\n招式學習器也拿去吧。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_11
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可不要誤會。\n我才不是要給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_13
text: ……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的目的達成了吧？\n讓我一個人靜靜。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_01
text: 天星隊的梅洛可，\n我希望妳見見一隻寶可夢。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_02
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_01
text: 炭！

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_03
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_15
text: 炭小侍？\n不對，你是……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_02
text: 炭炭！

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_16
text: 你是炭次郎嗎……\n為什麼你會……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_03
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_04
text: 這孩子似乎為了找妳，\n而到了基地來。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_04
text: 炭！

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_05
text: 看來牠很喜歡妳。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_18
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_19
text: 因為我在學院上學的時候，\n每天都和這傢伙玩在一起。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_20
text: 要知道牠在想什麼也難不倒我。\n我只要看牠的火焰搖擺的樣子就知道了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_06
text: 炭次郎是抱著什麼樣的想法，\n而來到這裡的呢？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_05
text: 炭炭！

label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_06
text: 炭炭！！

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_07
text: 依我看炭次郎像是在跟妳說，\n希望妳能回來……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_08
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_24
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_09
text: 聽說天星隊在基地裡\n構思著襲擊學院的計畫……？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_25
text: 竟然有那種八卦。\n從以前就是這樣，一點都沒變。\r\n那是絕對不可能的。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_10
text: [EMPTY 64]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_11
text: 妳剛剛不是騎著\n改造車四處打轉……？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_26
text: 天星隊車……\n那是以前為了打架而製造的。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_27
text: 但實際上用它對付的第一個對手，\n就是你們。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_12
text: 第一個……？\n以前打架的時候……？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_28
text: 你知道天星大作戰嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_13
text: 天星大作戰？\n而不是星塵大作戰？\r\n不，我第一次聽到這個名稱……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_29
text: 這樣啊。\n你果然不知道……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_30
text: 對我們天星隊來說，\n那是像寶物一般的回憶。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
